# springbot -- spring bot (episode 1 hopper, box 24 x 28, faces right)
# generated by tools/sprites/build.py -- do not edit by hand
# anchor = bottom centre of the box (the foot pad on the ground line)
# attack frames are lifted 2 px (the spring hangs below the body in the air)
# glow: red eyes, antenna bulb
frame 64 64
anchor 32 60
# idle: on the ground: spring compressed, bouncing, winding up
anim idle 10 loop 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7
# attack: in the air: spring stretched and wobbling, arms up
anim attack 12 loop 8 9 10 11 12 13 14 15
# hurt: jolted, sparks
anim hurt 14 loop 16 17 18
